_meta.warning: Analog Fit is a model-dependent screening similarity, not a match, ranking of real mission options, or safety rating.
_meta.missingDataRule: Missing layers are never imputed as zero; they lower Data Completeness and are listed by id.
_meta.exclusions: Pressure is reported but excluded from Moon/Mars fits.
_meta.confidenceNote: The band covers measurement, target-envelope and weight uncertainty only. Missing layers are not included.
_meta.sensitivityNote: The missing-data range assumes each unmeasured condition was equally likely to be a gap or a strong overlap. It is a sensitivity check, not a confidence interval.
